event_chain.summary: Systems and phone lines disrupted, taken offline

summary: Darlington County, South Carolina, took computer systems offline in August 2026 after a cybersecurity incident disrupted phone lines and some county services, though 911 and emergency operations kept working. Phone lines at two magistrate offices and the county Historical Commission remained down. The county brought in outside cybersecurity specialists and law enforcement but did not disclose the attack method, whether ransomware was involved, whether data was accessed, or who was responsible.
